name: The House on Limbo Lane
source:
You find yourself at the foot of a mansion atop a hill, unsure of what brought you here, who you are, and why you reek so horrifically. Taking shelter in the manor acquaints you with six ghosts—all of whom remain in the land of the living due to their sense of unrest.

Within your decrepit, decaying, nameless body, you begin resolving the unfinished business of each of the ghosts and solving the mansion’s many mysteries: the screams from beneath the floorboards, the oft-reported disappearances, and the origin of that ominous voice in your head. The choices you make will have a profound impact on the characters you meet, the fate of the mansion itself...and perhaps even your own destiny.

[From [url=https://finch-house-productions.itch.io/the-house-on-limbo-lane]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你发现自己站在一座山顶豪宅的脚下，不确定是什么把你带到了这里，你是谁，以及为什么你散发出如此可怕的臭味。在庄园里避难时，你会遇到六个鬼魂——他们都因为不安的感觉而留在了生者之地。

在你衰老、腐烂、无名的身体里，你开始解决每个鬼魂未完成的事情，并解开宅邸的许多谜团：地板下的尖叫声、经常报道的失踪事件，以及你脑海中不祥声音的来源。你所做的选择将对你遇到的角色、宅邸本身的命运……甚至你自己的命运产生深远的影响。

[来自[url=https://finch-house-productions.itch.io/the-house-on-limbo-lane]itch.io[/url]]
